name: 16866 · Philipsburg, PA
findings: ZIP 16866 (Philipsburg) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 16866 (Philipsburg) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 16866 (Philipsburg) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
